profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Unity | Backend & Infrastructure | Distributed Systems | PhD in Microbiology
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hi! I am May Kim and I write backend code and maintain cloud services infrastructure at Parsec in Unity Technologies. When I started having more fun making browser widgets and laboratory gadgets than doing actual research in my microbiology PhD program, I decided software engineering was a good path forward for me. I’ve contributed to all stack at Parsec, as well as building out internal metrics tools that others can use to improve their workflow. I enjoy working on the whole process of building an app, front to back and everything in between.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack development for Parsec for Teams admin dashboard and API with Typescript/ReactJS and Go. 
Infrastructure maintenance and development with AWS and Terraform.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · React.js · MySQL

positions.title: Web development student
positions.description:
- Intensive 15-week web development immersive program where I became proficient in Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, and ReactJS.
- Collaborated with another student to build wanderLost with jQuery and Google Maps API.
- Built the back end with Ruby on Rails and ActionCable for Send Doods, working together with another student building the front end.
- Developed SandboCSS for the independent capstone project using ReactJS and various packages to create an intuitive interface for coding-free CSS sandbox.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Performed experiments using molecular biology, microbiology, cell biology techniques.
- Supervised groups of 2-3 undergraduate research assistants every semester in close mentorship.
- Presented data during weekly meetings with PI, group meetings, and regional symposia.
- Collaborated with graduate students from other departments in interdisciplinary research projects.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Taught concepts, techniques, research methods, and scientific writing to classes of 24-32 students.
- Trained basic microbiological techniques in upper-level laboratory courses.
- Tracked progress and grade of individual student and report to the lead course instructor.

positions.title: Aviculture Intern
positions.description:
- Maintained bird enclosures and indoor open-floor exhibit in daily cleaning and placing enrichments in Australia Exhibit. 
- Navigated 64,500 sqft of exhibit floor to find and keep track of surviving and missing birds. 
- Provided meal delivery service for the birds on the exhibit. 
- Created an ethogram of the activity of a parrot with behavioral problems to search for triggers of self-harming habits.
